picks.game: Los Angeles Angels @ Boston Red Sox
picks.rationale: The Red Sox are in strong recent form, riding a four-game winning streak, while the Angels have dropped four of their last five games. Boston has dominated the head-to-head matchups this season, winning all three previous meetings. Angels starter Grayson Rodriguez has struggled significantly with a 6.03 ERA and 1.52 WHIP, providing a favorable matchup for the Red Sox offense. The line movement and public betting heavily favor Boston on the run line, indicating sharp money is backing the Red Sox to win by more than one run.

The Baltimore Orioles are in a significant slump, having lost six straight games entering this series. Conversely, the Cleveland Guardians have won three of the first four meetings between these two teams this season, demonstrating their ability to beat Baltimore. While the moneyline has moved slightly against Cleveland, the Guardians remain in the thick of the AL Central race, providing strong motivation. Orioles pitcher Trevor Rogers has a 4.30 ERA, which is higher than Guardians starter Joey Cantillo's 3.81 ERA, giving Cleveland an edge on the mound.

The Cincinnati Reds are sending ace Chase Burns to the mound, who boasts an impressive 15-3 record with a 2.79 ERA, giving them a strong chance to keep the game competitive against the Dodgers. The Dodgers have not announced a starting pitcher, creating uncertainty for Los Angeles, while Burns provides a known, high-quality arm for Cincinnati. Although the Dodgers are on a four-game winning streak, the Reds have shown more home run power this season, hitting 192 compared to the Dodgers' 174. The projected final score of Dodgers 4, Reds 3 suggests a close game, making the +1.5 run line for the Reds a valuable play.

The Athletics are severely hampered by injuries, with numerous key players, including Shea Langeliers and Brent Rooker, on the injured list, significantly weakening their lineup and overall team strength. Toronto's starting pitcher, Dylan Cease, has been dominant this season with a 10-5 record and a stellar 2.25 ERA, providing a significant pitching advantage over Athletics starter Jacob Lopez, who has a 4.71 ERA. The Blue Jays' pitching staff has also been in good form recently, posting a collective 3.68 ERA over their last 10 games. Given the Athletics' extensive injury list and the pitching mismatch, the Blue Jays are well-positioned to win by multiple runs.

Despite the Brewers' better overall record and home-field advantage, the pitching matchup favors the Cubs, with Matthew Boyd (4.05 ERA) outperforming Robert Gasser (4.57 ERA) in key metrics. Both teams are in similar recent form, with a 5-5 record over their last ten games, neutralizing any momentum advantage for Milwaukee. The projected final score of Milwaukee 4.9, Cubs 4.6 indicates a near-coin-flip outcome, making the plus-money odds on the Cubs a strong value play. The Brewers' team ERA is better, but the individual starter matchup and the value at plus money make the Cubs an appealing underdog.

picks.game: SMU Mustangs vs Florida State Seminoles
picks.rationale: SMU's offense, led by experienced quarterback Kevin Jennings and a strong offensive line, is poised to exploit Florida State's struggling defense, which allowed New Mexico State to convert 10-of-17 third downs and gave up explosive plays in Week 0. SMU also benefits from a historical trend where Week 1 teams playing their first game cover the spread at a 58% clip against Week 0 teams. Furthermore, Florida State has a poor recent ATS record, failing to cover in 8 of their last 10 games, and lost 11 of their last 13 conference games. The Mustangs also won the only prior head-to-head matchup by a significant margin.

Borussia Dortmund's recent form indicates high-scoring affairs, with their last 18 games averaging 3.11 goals and 61.1% going over 2.5 goals. They have started the 2026-27 season strongly in attack, scoring eight goals in their first three matches. The last head-to-head meeting at Signal Iduna Park saw Dortmund dominate with a 4-0 victory. Villarreal's defense has shown vulnerability in La Liga this season, conceding four goals in their first four matches, further supporting a high-scoring outcome.

Real Madrid enters this match severely hampered by a long list of injuries and suspensions, including key players like Militão, Mendy, Rodrygo, Camavinga, Bernardo Silva, and Güler, while Tchouaméni and Lunin are also doubts. Inter Milan, conversely, is in excellent domestic form, boasting a W6 D4 L0 record in their last ten Serie A matches and winning their last three league games. Despite Federico Dimarco's absence, Inter's overall squad health and strong momentum provide significant value against a heavily weakened Real Madrid side, who just suffered their first loss of the season.

Both Lille and Real Betis have demonstrated strong attacking capabilities in their respective domestic leagues this season, with Lille scoring five goals in three Ligue 1 matches and Real Betis netting five goals in four La Liga outings. Real Betis is facing significant defensive challenges due to injuries to several key players, including starting center-back Diego Llorente, which could lead to an open game. The only previous head-to-head encounter between these two teams resulted in a 2-2 draw, suggesting a historical precedent for goals.

Manchester City enters this Champions League fixture in impeccable form, having won all three of their opening Premier League matches with a perfect record. They hold a dominant head-to-head record against Porto, remaining unbeaten in their four previous meetings with three wins and one draw. Porto is dealing with notable defensive absences, including left-back Zaidu Sanusi who is out for the entire month of September, and Jan Bednarek who is suspended. Despite some minor injuries, City's formidable attacking depth, featuring players like Erling Haaland, Phil Foden, and Rayan Cherki, is expected to overcome Porto's challenges.

Manchester City's attack is consistently potent, with key players like Erling Haaland, Phil Foden, and Rayan Cherki known for their goal-scoring ability and contributing to high-scoring games. Porto's defense is weakened by the absence of left-back Zaidu Sanusi for the month and the suspension of Jan Bednarek, which could lead to more scoring opportunities for City. While the last head-to-head was a 0-0 draw, previous encounters between these teams have seen goals, including a 3-1 and 4-0 victory for City. Porto's strong domestic scoring form also suggests they could contribute to the goal tally at home, further supporting the Over.
